"""Process-level controls using temporary JSON receipt records, not native replay."""
import base64
import copy
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

root = Path('/var/folders/lt/z11pyzhj0m17vn798jkk69hh0000gn/T/opencode/lean-native-v2-R04/fixtures/profiles/playwright')
scratch = Path('/var/folders/lt/z11pyzhj0m17vn798jkk69hh0000gn/T/opencode')
historical = json.loads((root / 'capture-receipt.json').read_text())
recovery = json.loads((root / 'browser-recovery-receipt.json').read_text())
controls = []
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='R04-audit-controls-', dir=scratch) as directory:
    for label in ('body-changed', 'body-loss', 'coordinated-body-changed', 'retry-loss',
                  'partial-results', 'path-missing', 'screenshot-size', 'original'):
        old, new = copy.deepcopy(historical), copy.deepcopy(recovery)
        name = 'R04-browser-success-list' if label == 'screenshot-size' else 'R04-api-list'
        receipt = new if label == 'screenshot-size' else old
        tests = receipt['evidence'][name]['tests']
        items = [item for test in tests for result in test['results'] for item in result['attachments']]
        if label in ('body-changed', 'coordinated-body-changed'):
            next(item for item in items if item['name'] == 'body-evidence')['body'] = base64.b64encode(b'CORRUPTED').decode()
        elif label == 'body-loss':
            del next(item for item in items if item['name'] == 'body-evidence')['body']
        elif label == 'retry-loss':
            next(test for test in tests if test['title'] == 'flaky first attempt')['results'].pop()
        elif label == 'partial-results':
            del tests[0]['results'][0]['errors']
        elif label in ('path-missing', 'screenshot-size'):
            attachment = next(item for item in items if 'path' in item)
            files = receipt['artifacts'][name]['test-results']
            relative = attachment['path'].split('/test-results/', 1)[1]
            if label == 'path-missing':
                del files[relative]
            else:
                data = base64.b64decode(files[relative]['base64'])
                data = data[:16] + (799).to_bytes(4, 'big') + data[20:]
                files[relative] = {'base64': base64.b64encode(data).decode(), 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}
        if label == 'coordinated-body-changed':
            sidecar = old['artifacts'][name]['report.json']
            report = json.loads(sidecar['output'])
            def change(suites):
                for suite in suites:
                    change(suite.get('suites', []))
                    for spec in suite.get('specs', []):
                        for test in spec['tests']:
                            for result in test['results']:
                                for item in result['attachments']:
                                    if item['name'] == 'body-evidence' and test['projectName'] == 'api-a':
                                        item['body'] = base64.b64encode(b'CORRUPTED').decode()
            change(report['suites'])
            sidecar['output'] = json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n'
            sidecar['sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(sidecar['output'].encode()).hexdigest()
        old_path, new_path = Path(directory) / 'historical.json', Path(directory) / 'recovery.json'
        old_path.write_text(json.dumps(old, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
        new_path.write_text(json.dumps(new, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
        argv = [sys.executable, '-B', str(root / 'audit.py'), '--verify-only',
                '--historical-receipt', str(old_path), '--recovery-receipt', str(new_path)]
        proc = subprocess.run(argv, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=10)
        output = proc.stdout.decode()
        if label == 'original':
            assert proc.returncode == 0 and '14 cases' in output
        else:
            assert proc.returncode != 0 and name + ':' in output, (label, output)
        controls.append({'mutation': label, 'case': name if label != 'original' else 'all 14',
                         'exit': proc.returncode, 'argv': argv, 'output': output,
                         'outputSha256': hashlib.sha256(proc.stdout).hexdigest(),
                         'boundary': 'merged stdout/stderr pipe; completed process; UTF-8 exact',
                         'temporaryRecordOnly': True})
        print(label, 'exit', proc.returncode, 'case', name if label != 'original' else 'all 14')
receipt = {'scope': 'process-level read-time audit controls; no native replay or corpus changes',
           'auditAt': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
           'auditRecipeSha256': hashlib.sha256((root / 'audit.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
           'controlRecipe': {'output': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()},
           'priorBlindControl': json.loads((scratch / 'R04-audit-before.json').read_text()),
           'restoration': 'temporary receipts disposed; original capture/recovery receipts never written', 'controls': controls}
(root / 'audit-controls-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
